title: Targeting and Privacy in Mobile Advertising
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Machine-learning (XGBoost) click-prediction framework and counterfactual targeting/privacy regimes; package ships illustrative simulated data only.
design_notes: Code and Data/CodeTPMA.R: xgboost models on behavioral/contextual features (df1.csv) and match-value allocation under targeting regimes (df2.csv). No treatment timing or panel FE regression.
data_files_note: Both datasets are simulated per README.
data_provenance_note: README: 'Both datasets are simulated and bear no relationship to the real data used in the paper.'
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex record has no abstract. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
